title: Benefit Allowances, Deductibles and Claim Limits: Rate Card for the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans
content:
The benefit a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans can pay, what the customer bears on each accepted claim, and how many claims a plan answers for are fixed per plan on this card. Every figure is the coverage's own for that plan.

| | Manufacturer Limited Warranty | Belrose Care Plan 2-Year | Belrose Care Plan 3-Year | Belrose Care Plan 5-Year | Belrose Lifetime Care Plan | Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Deductible per accepted claim | 0.00 USD | 75.00 USD | 50.00 USD | 35.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Benefit allowance for one coverage year | 350.00 USD | 1200.00 USD | 2500.00 USD | 5000.00 USD | 12000.00 USD | 40000.00 USD |
| Benefit allowance over the whole life of the plan | 350.00 USD | 2400.00 USD | 7500.00 USD | 25000.00 USD | 60000.00 USD | 250000.00 USD |
| Yearly allowance granted afresh on each coverage anniversary | no | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Largest number of claims settled in a rolling twelve months | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 |
| Largest number of claims settled over the life of the plan | 1 | 4 | 9 | 20 | 40 | 60 |
| Calendar days that must pass between one settled claim and the next on the same plan | 90 | 60 | 45 | 30 | 14 | 0 |
| Ceiling on any one settlement, as a percentage of the item value recorded at purchase | 50.0 percent | 80.0 percent | 100.0 percent | 100.0 percent | 125.0 percent | 150.0 percent |
| Annual reduction applied to the settled value of the piece | 10.0 percent | 8.0 percent | 6.0 percent | 4.0 percent | 0.0 percent | 0.0 percent |
| How a total loss is answered | repair first | repair first | repair first | like-kind replacement | like-kind replacement | cash settlement |
| What a replacement is valued at | original purchase price | original purchase price | original purchase price | original purchase price | current retail replacement | current retail replacement |

## Notes on the card

- The deductible is what the customer pays out of pocket on each accepted claim; on the three plans whose deductible is 0.00 USD the customer pays nothing out of pocket under this card.
- The one-year allowance is the benefit available for settlements in one coverage year; the lifetime allowance is the benefit available over the whole life of the plan. On the Manufacturer Limited Warranty the two are the same figure, 350.00 USD, and the yearly allowance is not granted afresh.
- The settlement ceiling is a percentage of the item value recorded at purchase: on the Belrose Lifetime Care Plan and the Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan it stands above the whole value, at 125.0 and 150.0 percent, so a single settlement on those plans may exceed what the piece sold for.
- The minimum interval between settled claims is 0 days on the Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan, so on that plan alone no waiting time separates one settled claim from the next.
